# zvm Release Notes Instructions

Write concise release notes for users of zvm.

## Style

- Lead with user-visible changes.
- Group changes under short headings when there are multiple categories.
- Mention installation, registry, and platform behavior when affected.
- Avoid internal CI-only details unless they affect release confidence.
- Keep bullets short and concrete.

## Categories

Prefer these headings when applicable:

- Highlights
- Installation
- Registry
- CI and Release
- Fixes

## Skip

- Ignore mechanical documentation-only changes unless they affect installation or release usage.
- Ignore commit metadata, formatting-only changes, and generated files.
